observed_failure.blocker: selected symbol not current new-entry tradable: SHEIN.HK-PERP

root_cause.defect: Runtime V1 required every frozen representative to be current new-entry tradable before any historical M5 request.
root_cause.why_invalid_for_probe: Current order-entry permission is dynamic broker metadata and is not a prerequisite in the frozen probe purpose, which is read-only historical M5 availability/timestamp topology.
root_cause.official_semantics: ProtoOATradingMode ENABLED=0; other values restrict trading. Runtime V2 records this field instead of using it as a global historical-read gate.
